Staffing and training

SOPs, systems and quality

Budgets, contracts and financial administration

  • Payment reconciliation support; Finance owns invoicing and cash reconciliation

The visit handover.

The partner clinic provides visit requirements and retains clinical oversight. PerCuro coordinates the agreed staff, space, equipment and secure handover.

  1. Prepare the visitConfirm scope, training, scheduling, supplies and local readiness.
  2. Deliver agreed activitiesLocal research staff support visits, assessments, infusions, procedures and specimen handling.
  3. Return complete recordsHand over visit records securely and follow up on missing information or queries.
  4. Confirm completionThe investigator reviews returned records and resolves clinical questions. PerCuro tracks completion and service evidence.

Research / How we work

How we work

The operating model behind every package: five connected phases, clearly assigned roles and consistent records.

Five phases, from study opportunity to close-out.

In the full-service model, PerCuro coordinates the agreed research operation through these phases. Selected services map to the phases they support.

  1. Opportunity and feasibility

    Assess clinic and study fit. Define scope, staffing and budget inputs alongside investigator capacity.

  2. Start-up and activation

    Prepare study files and ethics documentation. Coordinate training, system access and local readiness.

  3. Participant and study delivery

    Coordinate schedules, data entry and queries. Local staff deliver visits, nursing and specimen handling.

  4. Management and follow-up

    Support amendments, renewals and monitoring. Track billing evidence and outstanding study work.

  5. Close-out and archiving

    Complete records and submissions, reconcile study finances and coordinate the archive handover.

The people around a study.

The proposed operating model connects clinical leadership, research coordination and local delivery.

Investigators

Clinical oversight, study decisions and required review and sign-off. Clinical questions are escalated to the investigator throughout study delivery.

Research coordination

Study planning, scheduling, documentation, data entry and follow-up, coordinated by the PerCuro hub within the agreed scope.

Research nurses and local staff

Agreed visit activities, procedures, specimen handling and records, delivered at the clinic.

Operational support

Training, systems, contracts and financial administration within clearly assigned responsibilities. Finance owns invoicing and cash reconciliation.

Records and quality.

Quality begins with clear responsibilities and consistent records.

Prepared teams

Protocol training, good clinical practice training, delegation and competency documentation within the agreed scope.

Consistent records

Defined procedures, filing structures and trackers. Original authors clarify or correct source records.

Secure handovers

Agreed arrangements for how records are transferred, checked and followed up, including monitoring support and archive handover.

Participant protection

Consent and ethics review are essential parts of clinical research. Study-specific arrangements are in place before participation begins.

Common questions.

What partnering with PerCuro could look like for a clinic or a study.

Can services be scoped to a specific study?

The service model supports individual packages, combined services or a full agreed research function. Study requirements, local capacity and responsibilities are confirmed together.

What stays with the principal investigator?

Investigator oversight, clinical decisions, required approvals, review and sign-off remain with the investigator. Sponsor systems remain sponsor-controlled.

Which activities happen locally?

Hands-on study work stays local, including visit preparation, nursing and study procedures, specimen handling and visit records. The PerCuro hub coordinates scheduling, records handover and follow-up within the agreed scope.

Can we use research nursing services on their own?

Yes. Research nursing and visit services are one selectable package. Agreed activities may include visits, assessments, infusions, procedures, specimen handling and visit documentation. Scope, staffing, training, space and equipment are confirmed before delivery.

Can you support our staffing and training needs?

The staffing and training package includes clinical research coordinator and research nurse support, temporary coverage, GCP and protocol training, and delegation and competency support. The staffing plan is agreed for the clinic and study.

How are budgets, billing and records handled?

The financial administration package includes study costing and budget negotiation, contract coordination, invoice support and payment reconciliation support. PerCuro supplies service evidence; Finance owns invoicing and cash reconciliation.

How do we assess recruitment and site experience?

Begin with the participant population, eligibility criteria, investigator experience and local recruitment pathway. Study-level evidence and site capacity are confirmed during feasibility; enrolment volumes and activation dates are assessed study by study.

Network

Where research would be delivered: PerCuro's specialty-care clinic network, and the research-site profile being built for each location.

The specialty-care footprint.

PerCuro by Sentrex is a Canadian specialty clinic network with 13 clinics. Its published history describes specialty-care experience in five areas.

  • Rheumatology
  • Inflammatory bowel disease
  • Immunology
  • Neurology
  • Oncology

These are specialty-care areas, not a list of research indications. Trial experience, investigator expertise and local capacity are confirmed study by study.

Research / About

About PerCuro Clinical Research

A research service grounded in PerCuro's specialty-care background.

A purpose rooted in patient care.

PerCuro by Sentrex is a Canadian specialty clinic network. Its mission centres on supporting patients, collaborating with healthcare providers and coordinating care with partners.

For clinical research, that means a practical focus on informed participation, clear clinical responsibilities and well-coordinated study work.

From specialty-care roots.

2003

Founded in British Columbia

PerCuro began with specialty infusion care for rheumatology patients, then expanded into inflammatory bowel disease.

2024

Joined Sentrex

Sentrex acquired PerCuro's four legacy clinics. The network expanded to 13 clinics that year.

These milestones describe the specialty-care business, not a timeline of clinical research activity. Investigator experience, completed studies and trial phases are added as research evidence is confirmed.

Our team.

Clinical leadership, research coordination and operational support.

Named leadership and investigator profiles are published once roles, credentials and biographies are approved.
